name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
